decision: Keep deferred worker copy only. All stronger geometry/storage prototypes reverted.

finalReplay.materialAdapter: Historical leafClass and vanilla snow/plant names; no full tag snapshot.
finalReplay.selectionCheck: Fresh selectors, 11 distances x 4 projection scales x 4 error settings x 31 face masks per mesh.

rejectedExperiments.name: sharing-full
rejectedExperiments.reason: 字节完全相同的记录共享，放开可用粗档；GPU 同档像素变化，撤回。

rejectedExperiments.name: terrain-sharing
rejectedExperiments.reason: 限制共享为非 feature 不透明地形；仍存在同档像素变化，撤回。

rejectedExperiments.name: ordered-sharing
rejectedExperiments.reason: 改成有序共同前后缀；像素通过，但工作量收益仅 0.38%，样本命令 64→384、GPU 0.139264→0.147456 ms，撤回。

rejectedExperiments.name: admitted-adjacency
rejectedExperiments.reason: 显示候选通过旧预算后做跨平面分组排序连接；避免预算倒退，但同档像素变化且收益偏小，撤回。

rejectedExperiments.name: consecutive-adjacency
rejectedExperiments.reason: 只合并连续同属性矩形；仍有同档像素变化，GPU 降幅不足，撤回。

rejectedExperiments.name: exact-tier-dedup
rejectedExperiments.reason: 完整有序档位逐字相同才共享；语料中无收益，撤回。
